scientific_integrity: All-parameter proof given; computational checks confined to \(S_3\) on two free orbits and the trivial group on up to five orbits. Unindexed equivalent results remain possible. No independent audit has occurred.
scientific_limitations: Finite free \(G\)-sets only; no classification for nonfree actions or for other semigroup conjugacy relations; formal exact class series without an asymptotic theorem. Literature indexing is incomplete.
title: Natural conjugacy and its exact class series for free finite \(G\)-sets
